title: Gazing into the Abyss
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji seized that fleeting moment of weakness, the entire protective formation of Tianji Pavilion suddenly blazed to life—the signal that the Pavilion Master of Tianji Pavilion had personally intervened!

text.content:
It was a pressure that defied all description.

As if the entire heavens and earth were bearing down at this very moment, the weight of countless eons pressing solely upon Chen Ji's shoulders. Deep within his Mental Sea, the tattered Tianji Record trembled violently, each page emitting mournful keening. And that 49th chess piece—the one that should have obeyed forever—was now vibrating at a maddening frequency, as if responding to some older, grander will.

Thin streams of blood seeped from Chen Ji's seven apertures, his bones crackling under the pressure. He felt like an ant gazed upon by the heavens' great eye,随时会被碾成齑粉.

dialogue.content:
「Ant.」

The voice did not come from outside, but exploded directly within his divine consciousness, as if Heaven's Way itself had pronounced judgment: 「You think obtaining a single fragment grants you the right to窥探天机? Laughable. You are merely an insignificant piece on my chessboard—and now, you shall learn obedience.」

A world-annihilating will surged through that trembling chess piece into Chen Ji's Mental Sea, forcibly rewriting his soul marks. This was the cleansing of Heaven's Way against the rebellious—a supreme, unbreakable force of dominion.

text.content:
Pain.

Intense agony rooted in the marrow spread from his Mental Sea throughout his entire body, as if millions of steel needles were simultaneously piercing his soul. Chen Ji felt his consciousness being stripped away layer by layer, those carefully laid plans he had built over years, those chess games woven with wisdom and endurance, all tottering before this force.

「Obey... Obey...」

That bewitching whisper echoed continuously in his divine consciousness, attempting to extinguish the final spark of rebellion in his heart.

text.content: A cold smile suddenly curved Chen Ji's lips, though drenched in blood, his eyes blazed with brilliance: 「Your power... does not seem to come from nothing. Who established these rules? And who... gave you the authority to judge all living beings?」

Chen Ji chose the third path—or rather, this was the timing he had been waiting for all along.

「Your power... does not seem to come from nothing.」 His voice remained clear despite the pressure, each word like a nail driven into the void, 「The Tianji Record states that all things have their rules. Dare I ask, Elder—did you establish these rules?」

In his Mental Sea, that crushing force abruptly faltered.

Chen Ji sensed it—the astonishment of Heaven's Way, the first subtle tremor of an ancient, unchanging will being touched. He had gambled correctly. This Transcendent Being was not truly invincible; its power stemmed from some... rule.

dialogue.content:
"'You...'

For the first time, the Heavenly Dao's will wavered, like a lake that had remained still for ten thousand years suddenly disturbed by a pebble: 'What are you saying?'

'I said,' Chen Ji slowly straightened up, blood dripping from his jaw, yet his smile grew even more pronounced, 'Senior is not invincible. Your power comes from rules—and rules mean being exploitable, means having loopholes.'

His spiritual consciousness suddenly contracted inward, using the Destiny Chessboard as a medium, tracing backward along the 49th chess piece's vibration frequency—he wanted to see what this self-proclaimed Heavenly Dao had built its power upon!"

text.content:
"In that instant, Chen Ji's spiritual consciousness pierced through layers of void, through the threads of destiny, through the web of karma—he saw it.

It was a chessboard vast and boundless, billions of times larger than the Destiny Chessboard he had constructed. And on the board, densely packed were countless points of light, each point a thread of fate, each point connecting to a 'prophet' like himself.

The Tianji Record Fragment... was merely a single chess piece on this giant board.

And the one truly controlling the board was, at this moment because of Chen Ji's prying, showing a trace of—panic?"

"'Enough!'

The Heavenly Dao's roar exploded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, the pressure suddenly multiplying several times over. Chen Ji felt like he had been thrown into the Heavenly Dao's furnace, his divine soul burning, his flesh dissolving, his bones fracturing.

'You saw something you shouldn't have, ant!' For the first time, there was anger in that voice, 'But this changes nothing—you are still just a piece, and a piece's fate has never been in its own hands!'

The 49th chess piece shuddered violently and began frantically devouring Chen Ji's Heavenly Fate Value!"

text.content: "Chen Ji's spiritual consciousness suddenly pierced outward, following the connection between the Tianji Record Fragment and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, sending an unprecedentedly powerful distress signal: 'Mo Xiansheng—!'"

"The moment Chen Ji sent the distress signal, the entire protective formation of the Pavilion of Heavenly Secrets suddenly lit up.

It was an ancient great formation that had lain dormant for a thousand years, now awakened by a faint distress signal. The formation's light pierced through layers of void, directly shining into Chen Ji's Mental Sea, colliding head-on with the Heavenly Dao's will pressure!

'Who dares—'

Before the Heavenly Dao's will's roar could even finish, an aged yet dignified voice rang in Chen Ji's ear: 'Young friend, hold on!'

It was Mo Xiansheng! The guardian of the Pavilion of Heavenly Secrets!"

"'Hmph.'

The Heavenly Dao's will's voice suddenly turned cold, the pressure originally concentrated on Chen Ji dispersing, part continuing to suppress Chen Ji while another part faced the protective formation's light.

'Pavilion of Heavenly Secrets... you wish to interfere as well?'

There was a hint of apprehension in that voice—Chen Ji敏锐地捕捉到了这一点. The Heavenly Dao's will was not invincible; what was it apprehensive about? The Pavilion of Heavenly Secrets's protective formation? Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul? Or... something else?

At this moment, Chen Ji sensed the crucial link—the Heavenly Dao's will's attention had been diverted!"

text.content: Chen Ji stopped his retreat, turning to face that Heavenly Dao's will: 'Senior's rules... who established them? Does your power also have limits?'

The moment Chen Ji spoke his question, the Heavenly Dao's will fell silent.

That silence was more terrifying than any roar, as if an ancient abyss were gazing, as if the void through countless calamities were responding. Chen Ji felt as though facing a mountain piercing the clouds—ask it questions, it will not answer, only using silence to tell you: you are not yet worthy.

Yet at this moment, a faint fluctuation arose from the depths of the Tianji Pavilion, briefly resonating with Chen Ji's divine sense. It was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul, using the last of its strength to transmit a message to him—

'Rules... First Generation... Tianji Pavilion Master...'

The information was fragmented, yet exploded in Chen Ji's Mental Sea like thunder. The Heavenly Dao's will's power stems from the rules, and the one who established those rules—was the first generation Pavilion Master of the Tianji Pavilion? That legendary existence?

Chen Ji raised his head abruptly, staring directly at that formless pressure: 'So that's it... Senior is not invincible, but bound by some rule. And the one who crafted this rule—'

'Enough!'

The Heavenly Dao's will's roar interrupted his words, but that brief silence had explained everything. The Heavenly Dao's will was afraid, afraid that Chen Ji had touched upon that ancient secret across eons!

'Little friend, go!'

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's ear, carrying resolve: 'You have touched upon Heavenly Dao taboos today; staying here means certain death. But after today, the Heavenly Dao's will's attention on you will increase severalfold—you have entered its sight.'

Entered its sight...

A bitter smile curved Chen Ji's lips. When these words came from Mo Xiansheng, they were no honor but crisis. Entering the Heavenly Dao's sight means from now on, he would no longer be dispensable dust on the chessboard, but a piece that must be eliminated or controlled.

But—who said a piece cannot turn the tables?

The moment Chen Ji was about to flee through the formation, the Heavenly Dao's will's voice sounded again, this time carrying a playful tone:

'Interesting... the first ant in ten thousand years to dare look directly at this One and demand the truth.'

The anger in that voice gradually faded, replaced by something far more dangerous—interest.

'This One has changed His mind. Killing you would be a waste—this One wishes to watch you grow, to see just how far this ant can go.'

Before the words finished, Chen Ji felt his body lighten—the world-annihilating pressure had vanished. And the No. 49 chess piece in his Mental Sea, far from being severed, had instead... been gilded with a faint golden sheen.

'This is this One's mark.' The Heavenly Dao's will's voice drifted over leisurely, 'From now on, no matter where you go, this One can perceive your existence. And you—'

That voice carried居高临下的傲慢: 'will forever be beneath this One's gaze. Struggle well, little ant. This One looks forward to the... surprises you bring this One.'

The words fell, and the pressure between heaven and earth completely dissipated. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, gasping heavily, his entire body drenched in cold sweat.

He had survived.

No—precisely speaking, from now on he would survive under the Heavenly Dao's will's gaze. But this also meant he had obtained a rare once-in-a-millennium opportunity: an opportunity to observe the Heavenly Dao up close and seek its flaws!

'Little friend...'

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul materialized from the formation, far more虚弱 than before, as if about to dissipate at any moment: 'Your actions today have completely enraged that one... but have also opened a new door.'

His voice grew solemn: 'Remember, the Heavenly Dao's will is not the true Heavenly Dao—it is merely—'

Before he could finish, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently, and the formation's light also dimmed abruptly at this moment.

Chen Ji raised his head sharply—he sensed it—while the Heavenly Dao's will's attention was entirely focused on him, a flaw had appeared in the Tianji Pavilion's protective formation. And within that flaw, a familiar aura was approaching...

That was the aura of the Tianji Pavilion Master!

The Tianji Pavilion's protective formation blazed suddenly, more brilliant than ever before.

It was a light carrying primordial might, bearing the will left by the first generation Pavilion Master of the Tianji Pavilion, surging straight toward the heavens, enveloping Chen Ji within. That light was warm and majestic, like the first ray of dawn when the Heavenly Dao was born, scattering all darkness and oppression.

And after that light, an aged yet majestic voice resounded throughout the entire Tianji Pavilion:

'The Eye of the Heavenly Dao... can you finally hold back no longer?'

This was the voice of the Tianji Pavilion Master, the signal of an ancient existence dormant for a thousand years awakening!

At this very moment, Chen Ji clearly perceived—the Heavenly Dao's will's attention had been completely diverted. The appearance of the Tianji Pavilion Master caused this self-proclaimed sovereign of Heaven, for the first time, to sense a true threat.

Chen Ji felt the vast and mighty power contained within that ancient light, and an indescribable shock surged in his heart. Is this the true depth of the Tianji Pavilion? Is this the ancient force capable of standing against the Heavenly Will? He quietly recorded this scene in his heart, carefully storing this intelligence deep within his Mental Sea. "Young friend." That aged voice rang out once more, but this time it echoed only in Chen Ji's ears: "Today's matter, you did well. To persist under the gaze of the Eye of Heaven until now, you are the first in ten thousand years." Chen Ji wanted to speak and ask, but discovered his spiritual sense was wrapped by a gentle force, unable to make a sound. "Now is not the time to speak." The voice continued, "The Eye of Heaven has marked you. From now on, every move you make is under its surveillance. But this is also an opportunity—" "When it looks at you, it cannot see others." As the voice fell, that ancient light suddenly gathered, transforming into a small token that steadily fell into Chen Ji's palm. The token was warm as jade, bearing an ancient "Ji" character—this was the token personally bestowed by the Pavilion Master of the Tianji Pavilion!

Chen Ji tightly grasped that token, countless thoughts churning in his heart. Everything he experienced today had fundamentally transformed the relationship between himself and the Heavenly Will. From a helpless ant being struck, to a "chosen" piece—this transformation came too swiftly, too quickly for him to fully absorb. But one thing he knew with absolute certainty: the appearance of the Tianji Pavilion's Pavilion Master signaled that this game had entered an entirely new phase. And he, Chen Ji, would play an increasingly significant role in this grand Chess Game spanning countless epochs. "Gazing into the abyss..." He murmured softly the chapter title of today, a meaningful curve forming at the corner of his lips. Whether the abyss was gazing back at him, he did not know. But one thing he was certain of— from today onward, he too was gazing into the abyss. And this gaze would ultimately determine a victor.

The moment Chen Ji secured the token, his spiritual consciousness suddenly quivered—that was the warning from the Destiny Chessboard. He hastily immersed his consciousness into the Mental Sea, only to witness dozens of chess pieces vibrating frantically upon the board, with several even developing cracks. This was extraordinarily unusual—these pieces represented the essence of his layouts over many years, each corresponding to crucial individuals or factions. "What's happening..." Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly as he began investigating the source of the vibrations one by one. First was the piece in the direction of the Xuanwu Sect—that was where Han Lie's faction resided, the vibrations most intense, as if something major was about to occur. Next was the direction of the Demonic Path Holy Sect, where Ye Qing's piece was located, equally trembling with anxiety. Then— Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. He saw a piece that had originally been vague and unclear, now gradually becoming distinct. Upon that piece, a young girl's silhouette faintly emerged— Chen Nian! His sister who had been missing for years, whose piece could never be foreseen due to her "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" identity, was now actively revealing herself! What did this mean? Had something happened to Chen Nian? Or had she finally found a way to break free from her constraints? Either possibility made Chen Ji's heart suddenly tighten. "Nian Nian..." He murmured softly, his eyes flickering with a rare tenderness and anxiety. That sister he had wronged for years, that family member he swore to find—had her fate finally begun to turn?

However, the situation did not allow Chen Ji to wallow excessively in personal emotions. He had just escaped alive from the Heavenly Will's overwhelming pressure, his Heavenly Fate Value depleted by大半, and his divine soul had sustained varying degrees of trauma. Without timely meditation and recovery, he risked suffering irreversible sequelae. More critically—the Heavenly Will had marked him. From now on, every action of his would be under the surveillance of those supreme eyes. This meant he could no longer use the Tianji Record's abilities as freely as before—each glimpse into the future would demand a heavier price. Yet within crisis often lurked opportunity. The Heavenly Will's "interest" in him might become a chance to approach the truth of Heaven. Since that lofty being wanted to observe how far this ant could struggle, he would perform for it to see. "Acting, then..." Chen Ji chuckled lightly, that smile carrying a hint of self-mockery and determination: "This is precisely my specialty." He slowly rose to his feet, his gaze piercing through layers of void, as if seeing that transcendent existence secretly observing him somewhere. "Watch closely, Heaven." He silently proclaimed within his heart: "Someday, the Chess Player controlling this board—will be me."
